RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the May 15, 2007/Vaisakha 25, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
177
Revival of sick PSEs by BRPSE
*561. SHRI C. RAMACHAN-
DRAIAH: Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Board for
Reconstruction of Public Sector Enterprises
(PSEs) is responsible for the revival of sick
PSEs;
(b) if so, how many PSEs have been
revived during the last three years;
(c) whether any time-bound programme
is in place to revive the ailing units;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
New airports and training centres in
NER
*562. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Planning
Commission has approved six new
airports in the North Eastern Region
including the BTAD area of Assam;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether his Ministry will
contemplate policy to set up new
institutes or training centres in some unused
old airports including Rupsi of Assam on
the lines of Pilot Training Centre, Ground
Engineering Institute or Air Hostess
Training Centre etc.;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Resource crunch in banks
*563. SHRIMATI  S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the unabated
credit expansion has resulted in a resource
crunch forcing banks to mobilize deposits
by raising interest rates;
(b) whether Government are aware that
some of the banks are reported to be seeking
bulk deposits from other banks at very
high interest rates to tide over the liquidity
problems; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken in this
regard?

178
Revealing of Participatory Notes
holders names by FIIs
*564. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Foreign
Institutional Investors are not bound to
reveal the names of Participatory Notes
holders which goes against the well
established concept of ‘know your
customers’, norms practiced world over;
(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that FIIs are
not allowed to issue PNs to Indian
nationals, persons of Indian origin;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(e) what steps Government have taken
to ensure that terrorists operating from
tax haven and routing their investments
and wrecking havoc on the Indian stock
market are not allowed?
External funding by JBIC
*565. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) how much external funding has been
provided by the Japan Bank for
International Cooperation (JBIC) during
financial years, 2005-06 and 2006-07;
(b) what are the guidelines of
Department of Economic Affairs for the
Central line Ministries to utilize such
funds;
(c) what are the monitoring guidelines
for the DEA to ensure total transparency,
accountability and prevention of
corruptive practices by funds utilizing
agencies; and
(d) when the Central line Ministry
reports to DEA/Finance Ministry the
illegalities and irregularities by the project
implementing agency, what action is taken
by DEA, who is central custodian/
guarantor for such externally-aided project
funds?
Tax holiday for tourism projects
*566. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
 Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether her Ministry propose to
declare a conditional 10 years tax holiday
from April, 2006 till March 31, 2007 for
all tourism projects in the country while
companies would enjoy full tax exemption
up to 50 per cent of the profit for enjoying
tax benefits for the balance amount, they
would be required to re-invest that part of
the profit in tourism projects; and
(b) whether her Ministry propose to
encourage investments from non-tourism
sector into hospitality and tourism
projects and are willing to give an additional
incentive package to invest in tourism
projects in hilly areas, rural areas and
pilgrim centres?
Loans to large, medium and SSIs
*567. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of loan sanctioned by
the commercial banks during the last three
years to large, medium and SSIs and
recovered, year-wise, industry size-wise
and bank-wise;
(b) the quantum of loan sanctioned under

by the commercial banks during the last

recovered, year-wise, industry-size-wise

List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the May 15, 2007/Vaisakha 25, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
993
FDI in Civil Aviation sector
4277. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
requested Government to review the 49
per cent cap on FDI in Civil Aviation sector;
and
(b) if so, whether Government have
taken any decision for throwing open the
sky to Foreign Direct Investment?
Decrease in cost per passenger mile
after merger
4278. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any report has been made
on how the cost per passenger-mile will be
affected after the merger of Air India and
Indian;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the cost will decrease and if
so, by what percentage; and
(d) if not, the purpose of the said
merger?
Emergency landings at
IGIA
4279. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that three
emergency/precautionary landings were
made by AI/Indian at IGI Airport, Delhi in
April, 2007, the cause of which has been
mainly attributed to hydraulic leakage;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government have already taken up the
issue of the hydraulic leakage in flexible
hoses with Airbus which has suggested
design changes, although some changes have
been carried out and the rest are still in
progress; and
(c) whether Government propose to
consider changing the old fleet on a war
footing to avoid such recurrence?

994
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Modernization of IGIA
4280. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Delhi
International Airport Ltd. has started
implementation of the Master Plan for the
expansion and modernization of Indira
Gandhi International Airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
so far undertaken by it; and
(c) by when the entire modernization
of the airport would be completed?
Special terminal at GMR-HIAL
4281. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a special
terminal for low cost airlines is being
constructed in the GMR-Hyderabad
International Airport Limited (HIAL);
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the proposals before Government
for utilization of the existing airport once
the GMR-HIAL airport becomes
operational at Hyderabad?
Decrease in air cargo fare
†4282. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is 15 to 20 per cent
decrease in air cargo fare during recent
period;
(b) if so, the main reasons therefor and
whether Government had prior information
in this regard;
(c) the efforts being made to avert it so
that aviation companies can be saved from
incurring loss; and
(d) by when Government efforts would
show their results?
New projects in Haryana
†4283. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of new airports proposed
to be set up by Government in the country
during the next one year;
(b) whether any project for setting up a
new airport or cargo airport in Haryana is
under consideration;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Encroachment in airports
4284. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether land belonging to airports
at different places in the country are under
encroachment;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether these encroachments in the
vicinity of airports are posing a danger to
aircrafts while landing or taking-off; and
(d) if so, the action being taken for
evacuation of the encroachers?
Air fares charged by Indian
4285. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether air fares charged by Indian

995
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
are very high when compared to that
charged by private airlines for different
domestic sectors;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether such dual fare environment
is increasingly making the Indian unpopular
and leading to its failure; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
proposed to be taken thereon?
Upgradation of Jollygrant
airport

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

(a) whether the work relating to
upgrading of Jollygrant airport of
Uttarakhand has been started;
(b) if so, whether there is any plan to
upgrade some more airstrips in the State;
and
